onboarding.title: First run: {{tenant}}
onboarding.subtitle: Five steps to the first result. Steps tick themselves off.

provider.title: Connect a cloud
provider.hint: Stands come up in your cloud: add a Yandex Cloud or AWS profile and verify it.
provider.guideYc: Where to get a Yandex Cloud key
provider.yc1: In the Yandex Cloud console create a service account in the folder for the stands.
provider.yc2: Grant it the editor role on that folder.
provider.yc3: Create an authorized key for the account and download the JSON.
provider.yc4: In Settings → Providers add Yandex Cloud, paste the key and press Verify.
provider.guideAws: Where to get an AWS key
provider.aws1: In IAM create a user with EC2 and VPC rights in the region.
provider.aws2: Issue an access key for it.
provider.aws3: In Settings → Providers add AWS, paste the key and press Verify.

test.title: Get a test
test.hint: Easiest is cloning an example: database, workload and sizes are set up.

launch.title: Launch it
launch.hint: Open the test and press Launch — the stand comes up in a few minutes.

results.title: See the results
results.hint: When the run finishes: QPS, latency, errors and charts over the load.
